Diagnosis.submission: The Jaeger deployment is misconfigured with replicas: 2 combined with pod anti-affinity rules that prevent multiple Jaeger pods from being scheduled on the same node. Additionally, the Jaeger PVC (jaeger-pvc) uses ReadWriteOnce access mode with node affinity bound to kind-worker. Since pod anti-affinity prevents both pods from running on kind-worker, and the RWO PVC cannot be mounted on other nodes, one Jaeger pod is permanently stuck in Pending state (FailedScheduling due to volume node affinity conflict), causing the deployment to report MinimumReplicasUnavailable.
